item: lark-status 卡点④ 手机真机 390px 回归

device.browser: Chrome/154.0.8037.126 (com.android.chrome), driven over adb forward tcp:9222 localabstract:chrome_devtools_remote

method: CDP over the real device's Chrome: Page.navigate, 6.5s settle, Runtime.evaluate measuring documentElement.clientWidth / scrollWidth, body.scrollWidth, window.innerWidth, devicePixelRatio and any element whose getBoundingClientRect().right exceeds the viewport; Page.captureScreenshot for each page. Exact-390 pass uses Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride(390x844, dsf 3, mobile) which is per-tab emulation, cleared afterwards - no device display change. Script: evidence/2026-10-07/phone390-probe.mjs

native_real_device_365px.note: narrower than the 390px target, therefore a stricter check

visual_check: zh cash comparison screenshot read back through the local OCR/vision intake: language switcher, cash/crypto tabs, currency CNY + amount 1000 and the THB direction control all render fully inside the viewport; no clipped or overlapping control observed.
anomaly_recorded_not_concluded: One phone-probe reading of /th/cash reported documentElement.lang='zh-CN' while the same page's server HTML is lang="th" and the component only ever assigns the route locale (components/language-switcher.tsx:10 takes ContentLocale). Not reproduced by curl and not chased further; recorded here rather than reported as a defect. No page reported a false lang in server output.
conclusion: No horizontal overflow on any of the 11 real-device page loads (7 at the device's native 365px, 4 at an exact 390px viewport). The 390px real-device regression item can be closed for the pages tested; it does not cover every one of the 71 sitemap URLs or a physical-device-only feature such as geolocation prompts.
actions: read-only: no production change, no deploy, no device display setting changed
